run_sqil_experiment: run the SQIL imitation learning experiment on a continuous control environment like HalfCheetah-v2
build_experiment_config: build an ExperimentConfig for SQIL using SAC agent with demonstration trajectories from TFDS datasets
run_distributed_sqil: run the SQIL experiment in distributed mode with 4 actors using LaunchPad and Docker resources
run_single_threaded_sqil: run the SQIL experiment single-threaded with periodic evaluation every 50000 steps
review_sqil_builder: review the SQILBuilder construction that wraps an SACBuilder with a demonstration data iterator
